sample_bounds: sample random lower and upper bounds of a given shape using a JAX random key
sample_bounded_points: sample uniformly distributed points that respect given lower and upper bounds
sample_bounded_simplex_points: sample points within bounds that also satisfy a simplex sum constraint
set_up_toy_problem: set up a toy neural network verification problem with bounded inputs and MLP parameters
test_sample_bounds: test the sample_bounds function generates valid lower and upper bound tensors
